item.title: Don't leave dead code behind
item.description: Keep things tidy; if the code is not being used, remove it. Don’t get attached. You have source control to look for it if you need it again. Dead code increases overhead, and understanding something unused will likely take some time.

item.title: AI coding warning
item.description: Enjoy the vibe, but remember, you are still responsible for your contributions. Do not lower your standards. AI tools can help you deliver more, but make sure to keep your standards ALWAYS review the bloody code properly and double-check dependencies.

item.title: All My HDDs Failed on UNRAID

item.title: Fail fast to learn fast
item.description: Just try it out, make it work, or don’t. Fail as fast as you can, and change directions as necessary. Embrace the failure as a great opportunity to learn.
